Software Engineer

Employer: Nalubega Health Systems Ltd
Seniority: Mid-level
Location: Kampala, Uganda. The work requires presence at the Kololo office.
Salary: UGX 2,500,000 gross per month
Apply by 30 November 2026.
Skills: Python, Django, PostgreSQL
Regional operational experience in East Africa is required.
Contact: careers@nalubegahealth.co.ug
The applicant does not pay a fee.

Data Entry Clerk

Employer: Lakeside Outreach
Location: Kampala. Presence at a Kampala office is required.
Applicants must pay a training deposit of UGX 80,000 in order to apply.
Send your CV to jobs.helper254@gmail.com.
Qualifications: typing.
Applicants must be under 30.

Invitation to bid for the supply of office furniture.

Procuring entity: Kampala Capital City Authority.
This is a public procurement tender. It is not an offer of paid work for a person.
Bids close on 15 December 2026.
Submit through the entity procurement portal.
